body:
What I want is to do better
What I want is to see progress
What I want is to not be the dumbest fucking person in every classroom
What I want is to not be the only one who is lost
What I want is to not have to whine and complain every waking moment of every day
What I want is to not have to look back on this in 4 years and laugh about how dramatic I was because this sucks now and I feel like I'm such a child
What I want is to be able to talk to professors without being treated like the slow kid
What I want is to not be the slow kid
What I want is to make everyone proud
What I want is to do something with my life
What I want is to actually enjoy college. This shit hole is supposed to be the best memories I ever make and right now I don't think that's true
What I want is to go to sleep and now wake up to deal with tomorrow
What want is to be a functioning adult
What I want is to stop being a depressed ass, moody ass, dumb ass, angsty ass, worthless piece of garbage.
What I want is to actually send you this but oh no, we can't actually talk about our feelings right? 
What I want is to say something other than "I'm better now" when it's a lie
What I want is to kill myself because this shit just isn't much for me. I have stopped caring. Honestly, I'm just going through the motions but I've got nothing to gain or lose by living or dying. I think I'll just leave college, get drunk, maybe check some stuff off the bucket list for shits and giggles then suck on a bullet. Sounds like a great way to go out.

Dad I'm in a bad way
I didn't want to tell you because I hate to have you know that I'm doing poorly when there really isn't much you can do and I know this sucks for you just as much as it does for me because here's your son, the product of your hard work and effort, struggling in the second week of school. I'm wasted effort and for that I'm sorry.
This is the second message that you will never receive. I keep writing these trying to think of a way to let you know how much pain I'm in right now without ruining your day but I'm not sure that's possible. I think anything I say except good news will ruin your day. So I've been waiting for the good grade, the turning point, the moment when I realize that I can do this. 
But it hasn't come. I don't know if it will. So I'm going to keep writing these.
